dataset_info.description: Temple University Hospital Abnormal EEG Corpus: clinical EEG recordings labelled normal or abnormal.
dataset_info.reference: Lopez, S. (2017). Automated Identification of Abnormal EEGs. Temple University.
dataset_info.notes: Compass: 2,383 subjects, 21 channels, 250 Hz, 10 s windows, 53,604 windows; first 3 min of each recording; 10-fold subject split. A recording is a pruned segment (t000, t001, ...) of the patient's EEG.
